older_price_cross_check.interpretation: Different vendor page displays older/lower starting figures. Use directly inspected dedicated pricing page as current observation; no effective date, identical contract scope or realized price increase established.

scope_warning: Advertised prices and product mechanics are market supply/monetization signals, not verified subscriptions, realized revenue, conversion, market share, competitor accuracy, or AgentMine customer evidence. No purchase, sign-in, trial or customer contact.
